title: Ingenium — from idea to editable study
audio: Silent by design. Optional recording script supplied separately.

scenes.title:
An idea.
Something you can see.
scenes.caption: Turn an idea into something you can see, edit and discuss.

scenes.title:
You don't need
a perfect brief.
scenes.caption: Start with a question, an existing artifact, or a direction you can't quite describe.

scenes.title:
Make a study.
Get a reaction.
scenes.caption: Ask for a useful study. See what feels right. Keep the source open for revision.

scenes.title:
Give an idea
a clear form.
scenes.caption: A publication cover turns a theme into type, color and a relationship between shapes.

scenes.title:
Build something
you can explore.
scenes.caption: A responsive website carries the same intent into layout, interaction and a smaller screen.

scenes.title:
Find a system.
Let it travel.
scenes.caption: An identity study tests a mark, its variations, and an event poster in the same visual language.

scenes.title:
Make relationships
easier to read.
scenes.caption: A wayfinding study makes destinations and directions visible. Real-world use needs its own checks.

scenes.eyebrow: FIRST SUCCESS / ACTUAL LOCAL HELPER RUN
scenes.title:
Try one
editable example.
scenes.caption: Run the included composition example, then use the optional helper to export a PNG.

scenes.title:
See the result.
Keep the structure.
scenes.caption: The clean SVG stays editable. A companion guide view makes the layout choices inspectable.

scenes.title:
Compare choices.
Name what matters.
scenes.caption: Keep earlier studies. Compare their choices. A later revision isn't proof of a better design.

scenes.title:
A useful next edit
starts with a reaction.
scenes.caption: Say what to keep and what to change. A choice belongs to this study, not to a permanent taste score.

scenes.title:
See it. Edit it.
Talk about it.
scenes.caption: Explore the editable examples. Bring a question. Develop a direction with Ingenium.
